import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import defs = "./definitions.qui"

class Context(defs.Macro[] definitions := [], table := map<string, int>(), defs.Diagnostic[] diagnostics := [], uses := [0, 0, 0], counter := 0)
class Pending(lexer.Token token, int next)
class Collected(lexer.Token[][] arguments, int remaining, lexer.Token closing)
class Item(bool is_paste, lexer.Token[] sequence)

void diagnostic(Context &context, const defs.Position position, string kind, string message)
    context.diagnostics = context.diagnostics.append(defs.Diagnostic(position, kind, message))

void expansion_error(Context &context, const lexer.Token invocation, string display_name, int offset, string message)
    diagnostic(&context, defs.Position(display_name, invocation.line + offset), "error", message)

lexer.Token[] expand(Context &context, const lexer.Token[] tokens, string display_name, int offset);

Collected | none collect(Context &context, const defs.Macro definition, const Pending[] pending, int head, const lexer.Token invocation, string display_name, int offset)
    lexer.Token[][] arguments := [[]]
    lexer.Token[] separators := []
    depth := 0
    cursor := pending[head].next
    closing_index := -1
    while cursor != -1
        current := pending[cursor].token
        if current.text == ")" and depth == 0
            closing_index = cursor
            break
        if current.text == "," and depth == 0
            separators = separators.append(current)
            arguments = arguments.append([])
        else
            if current.text == "("
                depth += 1
            elif current.text == ")"
                depth -= 1
            last := int(#arguments) - 1
            arguments[last] = arguments[last].append(current)
        cursor = pending[cursor].next
    if closing_index == -1
        expansion_error(&context, invocation, display_name, offset, "unterminated argument list invoking macro {DQ}{definition.name}{DQ}")
        return none
    count := int(#arguments)
    required := int(#definition.parameters) - (if definition.variadic then 1 else 0)
    empty_zero := not definition.variadic and required == 0 and count == 1 and #arguments[0] == 0
    message := ""
    if not definition.variadic and required == 0 and not empty_zero
        message = "macro {DQ}{definition.name}{DQ} passed {count} arguments, but takes just 0"
    elif count < required
        message = "macro {DQ}{definition.name}{DQ} requires {required} arguments, but only {count} given"
    elif count > required and not definition.variadic
        message = "macro {DQ}{definition.name}{DQ} passed {count} arguments, but takes just {required}"
    if message != ""
        expansion_error(&context, invocation, display_name, offset, message)
        return none
    if definition.variadic
        lexer.Token[] variable := []
        for: required <= index < count
            if index > required
                variable = variable.append(separators[index - 1])
            variable = variable.concat(arguments[index])
        arguments = arguments[0:<required].append(variable)
    elif empty_zero
        arguments = []
    return Collected(arguments, pending[closing_index].next, pending[closing_index].token)

int parameter_index(const string[] names, string sought)
    for: index < int(#names)
        if names[index] == sought
            return index
    return -1

lexer.Token stringize(const lexer.Token[] tokens, const lexer.Token template)
    text := ""
    for: index < int(#tokens)
        token := tokens[index]
        if index > 0 and token.space
            text += " "
        if token.kind == "string" or token.kind == "character"
            for: character_index < int(#token.text)
                character := token.text[character_index]
                if character == "\" or character == DQ
                    text += "\"
                text += character
        else
            text += token.text
    return lexer.Token("string", DQ + text + DQ, template.line, template.space)

lexer.Token[] paste(Context &context, const lexer.Token first, const lexer.Token second, const lexer.Token invocation, string display_name, int offset)
    right := second
    if first.kind == "placemarker"
        right.space = first.space
        return [right]
    if right.kind == "placemarker"
        return [first]
    text := first.text + right.text
    match lexer.single(text)
        string kind
            return [lexer.Token(kind, text, first.line, first.space, lexer.intersection(first.hide, right.hide))]
        none
            expansion_error(&context, invocation, display_name, offset, "pasting {DQ}{first.text}{DQ} and {DQ}{right.text}{DQ} does not give a valid preprocessing token")
            right.space = false
            return [first, right]

lexer.Token[] substitute(Context &context, const defs.Macro definition, const lexer.Token[][] arguments, const lexer.Token invocation, const string[] hide, string display_name, int offset)
    map<int, lexer.Token[]> cache
    Item[] items := []
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#definition.replacement)
        token := definition.replacement[cursor]
        if token.text == "#" and definition.function_like
            parameter := parameter_index(definition.parameters, definition.replacement[cursor + 1].text)
            items = items.append(Item(false, [stringize(arguments[parameter], token)]))
            cursor += 2
            continue
        if token.text == "##"
            items = items.append(Item(true, [token]))
        else
            parameter := if token.kind == "identifier" then parameter_index(definition.parameters, token.text) else -1
            if parameter >= 0
                raw := (cursor > 0 and definition.replacement[cursor - 1].text == "##") or (cursor + 1 < int(#definition.replacement) and definition.replacement[cursor + 1].text == "##")
                lexer.Token[] sequence := []
                if raw
                    sequence = arguments[parameter]
                else
                    match cache.get(parameter)
                        lexer.Token[] found
                            sequence = found
                        none
                            sequence = expand(&context, arguments[parameter], display_name, offset)
                            .cache.set(parameter, sequence)
                if #sequence == 0
                    sequence = [lexer.Token("placemarker", "", token.line, token.space)]
                else
                    sequence[0].space = token.space
                items = items.append(Item(false, sequence))
            else
                items = items.append(Item(false, [token]))
        cursor += 1
    lexer.Token[] output := []
    cursor = 0
    while cursor < int(#items)
        entry := items[cursor]
        if not entry.is_paste
            output = output.concat(entry.sequence)
        else
            last := int(#output) - 1
            left := output[last]
            output = output[0:<last]
            right := items[cursor + 1].sequence
            output = output.concat(paste(&context, left, right[0], invocation, display_name, offset))
            output = output.concat(right[1:<int(#right)])
            cursor += 1
        cursor += 1
    lexer.Token[] result := []
    inherited_space := false
    for token := output[]
        if token.kind == "placemarker"
            inherited_space = inherited_space or token.space
            continue
        token.line = invocation.line
        token.space = token.space or inherited_space
        token.hide = lexer.unique(token.hide.concat(hide))
        result = result.append(token)
        inherited_space = false
    if #result > 0
        result[0].space = invocation.space
    return result

lexer.Token[] expand(Context &context, const lexer.Token[] tokens, string display_name, int offset)
    Pending[] pending := []
    head := -1
    for token := tokens[::-1][]
        pending = pending.append(Pending(token, head))
        head = int(#pending) - 1
    lexer.Token[] result := []
    while head != -1
        invocation := pending[head].token
        head = pending[head].next
        if invocation.kind != "identifier" or lexer.has(invocation.hide, invocation.text)
            result = result.append(invocation)
            continue
        if defs.builtin(invocation.text)
            kind := "number"
            text := ""
            if invocation.text == "__LINE__"
                context.uses[0] += 1
                text = "{invocation.line + offset}"
            elif invocation.text == "__FILE__"
                context.uses[1] += 1
                kind = "string"
                text = DQ + display_name + DQ
            else
                context.uses[2] += 1
                text = "{context.counter}"
                context.counter += 1
            result = result.append(lexer.Token(kind, text, invocation.line, invocation.space))
            continue
        definition_index := -1
        match context.table.get(invocation.text)
            int found
                definition_index = found
            none
                result = result.append(invocation)
                continue
        definition := context.definitions[definition_index]
        lexer.Token[][] arguments := []
        hide := invocation.hide
        if definition.function_like
            if head == -1 or pending[head].token.text != "("
                result = result.append(invocation)
                continue
            match collect(&context, definition, pending, head, invocation, display_name, offset)
                Collected found
                    arguments = found.arguments
                    head = found.remaining
                    hide = lexer.intersection(hide, found.closing.hide)
                none
                    result = result.append(invocation)
                    continue
        hide = lexer.unique(hide.append(definition.name))
        replacement := substitute(&context, definition, arguments, invocation, hide, display_name, offset)
        context.definitions[definition_index].expanded += 1
        if #replacement == 0 and invocation.space and head != -1
            pending[head].token.space = true
        for token := replacement[::-1][]
            pending = pending.append(Pending(token, head))
            head = int(#pending) - 1
    return result

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import defs = "./definitions.qui"

class Node(string kind, spelling := "", value := 0, int[] children := [])
class Parser(lexer.Token[] tokens, cursor := 0, Node[] nodes := [], string | none problem := none)
class Message(string kind, string text)
class Evaluation(Message[] messages := [], failed := false)
class Result(int | none value, Message[] messages)

string peek(const Parser parser)
    return if parser.cursor < int(#parser.tokens) then parser.tokens[parser.cursor].text else ""

int add_node(Parser &parser, Node node)
    parser.nodes = parser.nodes.append(node)
    return int(#parser.nodes) - 1

void fail(Parser &parser, string message)
    match parser.problem
        string previous
            return
        none
            parser.problem = message

int | defs.Problem constant(const lexer.Token token)
    original := token.text
    if token.kind == "character"
        body := original[1:<int(#original) - 1]
        if #body == 1 and body != "'" and body != "\"
            return body.codepoints()[0]
        if #body == 2 and body[0] == "\"
            string[] escapes := ["n", "t", "\", "'", DQ, "0"]
            values := [10, 9, 92, 39, 34, 0]
            for: index < int(#escapes)
                if escapes[index] == body[1]
                    return values[index]
        return defs.Problem("invalid character constant {original}")
    body := original
    for suffix := ["ll", "LL", "l", "L"][]
        if #body > #suffix and body.ends_with(suffix)
            body = body[0:<int(#body) - int(#suffix)]
            break
    base := 10
    digits := body
    if body.starts_with("0x") or body.starts_with("0X")
        base = 16
        digits = body[2:<int(#body)]
    elif body.starts_with("0")
        base = 8
    valid := #digits > 0
    value := 0
    for: index < int(#digits)
        character := digits[index]
        digit_value := -1
        if lexer.digit(character)
            digit_value = character.codepoints()[0] - 48
        elif character.codepoints()[0] >= 97 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 102
            digit_value = character.codepoints()[0] - 87
        elif character.codepoints()[0] >= 65 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 70
            digit_value = character.codepoints()[0] - 55
        if digit_value < 0 or digit_value >= base
            valid = false
            break
        value = value * base + digit_value
    if valid
        return value
    return defs.Problem("invalid integer constant {DQ}{original}{DQ}")

int priority(string spelling)
    if spelling == "||"
        return 1
    if spelling == "&&"
        return 2
    if spelling == "|"
        return 3
    if spelling == "^"
        return 4
    if spelling == "&"
        return 5
    if lexer.has(["==", "!="], spelling)
        return 6
    if lexer.has(["<", ">", "<=", ">="], spelling)
        return 7
    if lexer.has(["<<", ">>"], spelling)
        return 8
    if lexer.has(["+", "-"], spelling)
        return 9
    if lexer.has(["*", "/", "%"], spelling)
        return 10
    return 0

int parse_expression(Parser &parser);

int unary(Parser &parser)
    match parser.problem
        string previous
            return 0
        none
            if lexer.has(["+", "-", "!", "~"], peek(parser))
                operation := peek(parser)
                parser.cursor += 1
                child := unary(&parser)
                return add_node(&parser, Node("unary", operation, children = [child]))
    if parser.cursor == int(#parser.tokens)
        fail(&parser, "expected value at end of expression")
        return 0
    token := parser.tokens[parser.cursor]
    parser.cursor += 1
    if token.kind == "number" or token.kind == "character"
        match constant(token)
            int value
                return add_node(&parser, Node("value", value = value))
            defs.Problem problem
                fail(&parser, problem.reason)
                return 0
    if token.kind == "identifier"
        return add_node(&parser, Node("identifier", token.text))
    if token.text == "("
        child := parse_expression(&parser)
        if peek(parser) != ")"
            fail(&parser, "missing ')' in expression")
        else
            parser.cursor += 1
        return child
    fail(&parser, "expected value before {DQ}{token.text}{DQ}")
    return 0

int binary(Parser &parser, int minimum)
    left := unary(&parser)
    while priority(peek(parser)) >= minimum
        match parser.problem
            string previous
                return left
            none
                operation := peek(parser)
                parser.cursor += 1
                right := binary(&parser, priority(operation) + 1)
                left = add_node(&parser, Node("binary", operation, children = [left, right]))
    return left

int parse_expression(Parser &parser)
    condition := binary(&parser, 1)
    if peek(parser) != "?"
        return condition
    parser.cursor += 1
    yes_branch := parse_expression(&parser)
    if peek(parser) != ":"
        fail(&parser, "'?' without following ':'")
        return condition
    parser.cursor += 1
    no_branch := parse_expression(&parser)
    return add_node(&parser, Node("conditional", children = [condition, yes_branch, no_branch]))

int power_two(int exponent)
    result := 1
    for: iteration < exponent
        result *= 2
    return result

int evaluate(const Node[] nodes, int index, Evaluation &evaluation)
    if evaluation.failed
        return 0
    node := nodes[index]
    if node.kind == "value"
        return node.value
    if node.kind == "identifier"
        evaluation.messages = evaluation.messages.append(Message("warning", "identifier {DQ}{node.spelling}{DQ} evaluates to 0"))
        return 0
    left := evaluate(nodes, node.children[0], &evaluation)
    if evaluation.failed
        return 0
    if node.kind == "conditional"
        return evaluate(nodes, node.children[if left != 0 then 1 else 2], &evaluation)
    operation := node.spelling
    if node.kind == "unary"
        if operation == "+"
            return left
        if operation == "-"
            return -left
        if operation == "!"
            return if left == 0 then 1 else 0
        return -left - 1
    if operation == "&&" and left == 0
        return 0
    if operation == "||" and left != 0
        return 1
    right := evaluate(nodes, node.children[1], &evaluation)
    if evaluation.failed
        return 0
    if (operation == "/" or operation == "%") and right == 0
        evaluation.failed = true
        evaluation.messages = evaluation.messages.append(Message("error", "division by zero in #if"))
        return 0
    if operation == "+"
        return left + right
    if operation == "-"
        return left - right
    if operation == "*"
        return left * right
    if operation == "/"
        return left / right
    if operation == "%"
        return left % right
    if operation == "<<"
        return left * power_two(right)
    if operation == ">>"
        divisor := power_two(right)
        result := left / divisor
        return result - (if left < 0 and left % divisor != 0 then 1 else 0)
    if operation == "&"
        return int(int32(left) AND int32(right))
    if operation == "|"
        return int(int32(left) OR int32(right))
    if operation == "^"
        return int(int32(left) XOR int32(right))
    if operation == "&&" or operation == "||"
        return if right == 0 then 0 else 1
    if operation == "<"
        return if left < right then 1 else 0
    if operation == ">"
        return if left > right then 1 else 0
    if operation == "<="
        return if left <= right then 1 else 0
    if operation == ">="
        return if left >= right then 1 else 0
    if operation == "=="
        return if left == right then 1 else 0
    return if left != right then 1 else 0

Result test(const lexer.Token[] tokens, string directive)
    if #tokens == 0
        return Result(none, [Message("error", "#{directive} with no expression")])
    parser := Parser(tokens)
    root := parse_expression(&parser)
    match parser.problem
        string problem
            return Result(none, [Message("error", problem)])
        none
            if parser.cursor != int(#tokens)
                return Result(none, [Message("error", "missing binary operator before {DQ}{tokens[parser.cursor].text}{DQ}")])
    evaluation := Evaluation()
    value := evaluate(parser.nodes, root, &evaluation)
    return Result(if evaluation.failed then none else value, evaluation.messages)

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"

class SourceFile(string path, lexer.LogicalLine[] lines, int physical_lines, string | none guard, entered := 0, skipped := 0, output_lines := 0, skipped_lines := 0, once := false)
class Manager(SourceFile[] files := [], lookup := map<string, int>(), string[] order := [])

string | none search(string name, bool quoted)
    if quoted
        bool exists := file.exists("input/{name}")
        if exists
            return name
    path := "include/{name}"
    bool exists := file.exists("input/{path}")
    if exists
        return path
    return none

string | none guard_name(const lexer.LogicalLine[] original)
    lexer.LogicalLine[] lines := []
    for line := original[]
        if #line.tokens > 0
            lines = lines.append(line)
    if #lines == 0
        return none
    lexer.Token[] first := lines[0].tokens
    lexer.Token[] last := lines[-1].tokens
    if #first != 3 or first[0].text != "#" or first[1].text != "ifndef" or first[2].kind != "identifier" or #last != 2 or last[0].text != "#" or last[1].text != "endif"
        return none
    depth := 0
    for: position < int(#lines)
        lexer.Token[] tokens := lines[position].tokens
        directive := if #tokens >= 2 and tokens[0].text == "#" and tokens[1].kind == "identifier" then tokens[1].text else ""
        if depth == 1 and lexer.has(["elif", "elifdef", "elifndef", "else"], directive)
            return none
        if lexer.has(["if", "ifdef", "ifndef"], directive)
            depth += 1
        elif directive == "endif"
            depth -= 1
        if depth == 0 and position + 1 != int(#lines)
            return none
    if depth == 0
        return first[2].text
    return none

int enter(Manager &manager, string path)
    index := -1
    match manager.lookup.get(path)
        int found
            index = found
        none
            string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/{path}"))
            lexer.LogicalLine[] lines := lexer.lex(text)
            physical_lines := 0
            for: position < int(#text)
                if text[position] == NL
                    physical_lines += 1
            index = int(#manager.files)
            manager.files = manager.files.append(SourceFile(path, lines, physical_lines, guard_name(lines)))
            manager.order = manager.order.append(path)
            .manager.lookup.set(path, index)
    manager.files[index].entered += 1
    return index

class Token(string kind, string text, int line, bool space, string[] hide := [])
class LogicalLine(Token[] tokens, int start, int end)
class ReadToken(string kind, int length)

bool has<T>(const T[] items, T sought)
    for item := items[]
        if item == sought
            return true
    return false

string[] unique(const string[] items)
    string[] result := []
    for item := items[]
        if not has(result, item)
            result = result.append(item)
    return result

string[] intersection(const string[] first, const string[] second)
    string[] result := []
    for item := first[]
        if has(second, item)
            result = result.append(item)
    return result

string repeat(string text, int count)
    result := ""
    for: iteration < count
        result += text
    return result

bool letter(string character)
    return (character.codepoints()[0] >= 65 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 90) or (character.codepoints()[0] >= 97 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 122)

bool digit(string character)
    return character.codepoints()[0] >= 48 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 57

ReadToken one(string text, start := 0, header := false)
    if start == int(#text)
        return ReadToken("other", 0)
    character := text[start]
    if header and character == "<"
        finish := start + 1
        while finish < int(#text) and text[finish] != NL and text[finish] != ">"
            finish += 1
        if finish < int(#text) and text[finish] == ">"
            return ReadToken("header", finish - start + 1)
    if letter(character) or character == "_"
        finish := start + 1
        while finish < int(#text) and (letter(text[finish]) or digit(text[finish]) or text[finish] == "_")
            finish += 1
        return ReadToken("identifier", finish - start)
    if digit(character) or (character == "." and start + 1 < int(#text) and digit(text[start + 1]))
        finish := start + 1
        while finish < int(#text)
            if "eEpP".contains(text[finish]) and finish + 1 < int(#text) and "+-".contains(text[finish + 1])
                finish += 2
            elif letter(text[finish]) or digit(text[finish]) or "_.".contains(text[finish])
                finish += 1
            else
                break
        return ReadToken("number", finish - start)
    if character == "'" or character == DQ
        finish := start + 1
        while finish < int(#text) and text[finish] != NL
            if text[finish] == character
                return ReadToken(if character == "'" then "character" else "string", finish - start + 1)
            if text[finish] == "\" and finish + 1 < int(#text) and text[finish + 1] != NL
                finish += 2
            else
                finish += 1
    punctuators := ["...", "<<=", ">>=", "->", "++", "--", "<<", ">>", "<=", ">=", "==", "!=", "&&", "||", "*=", "/=", "%=", "+=", "-=", "&=", "^=", "|=", "##"]
    remaining := text[start:<int(#text)]
    for punctuator := punctuators[]
        if remaining.starts_with(punctuator)
            return ReadToken("punctuator", int(#punctuator))
    return ReadToken(if "[](){{}}.&*+-~!/%<>^|?:;=,#".contains(character) then "punctuator" else "other", 1)

string | none single(string text)
    if text == "" or text.starts_with("//") or text.starts_with("/*")
        return none
    token := one(text)
    if token.length == int(#text)
        return token.kind
    return none

bool separator(string left, string right)
    return (left == "/" and (right.starts_with("/") or right.starts_with("*"))) or one(left + right).length != int(#left)

string render(const Token[] tokens, output := false)
    result := ""
    for: position < int(#tokens)
        token := tokens[position]
        if position > 0 and (token.space or (output and separator(tokens[position - 1].text, token.text)))
            result += " "
        result += token.text
    return result

LogicalLine[] lex(string source)
    spliced := ""
    int[] physical := []
    position := 0
    line_number := 1
    while position < int(#source)
        if source[position] == "\" and position + 1 < int(#source) and source[position + 1] == NL
            position += 2
            line_number += 1
            continue
        spliced += source[position]
        physical = physical.append(line_number)
        if source[position] == NL
            line_number += 1
        position += 1
    LogicalLine[] result := []
    Token[] tokens := []
    start := 1
    space := true
    position = 0
    while position < int(#spliced)
        if spliced[position] == " "
            position += 1
            space = true
            continue
        if spliced[position] == NL
            finish := physical[position]
            result = result.append(LogicalLine(tokens, start, finish))
            tokens = []
            start = finish + 1
            position += 1
            space = true
            continue
        remaining := spliced[position:<int(#spliced)]
        if remaining.starts_with("//")
            while position < int(#spliced) and spliced[position] != NL
                position += 1
            space = true
            continue
        if remaining.starts_with("/*")
            position += 2
            while spliced[position:<position + 2] != "*/"
                position += 1
            position += 2
            space = true
            continue
        header := #tokens == 2 and tokens[0].text == "#" and tokens[1].text == "include"
        token := one(spliced, position, header)
        tokens = tokens.append(Token(token.kind, spliced[position:<position + token.length], physical[position], space))
        position += token.length
        space = false
    if #tokens > 0
        result = result.append(LogicalLine(tokens, start, line_number))
    return result

import defs = "./definitions.qui"
import expression = "./expression.qui"
import expander = "./expander.qui"
import includes = "./include_manager.qui"

class Header(string name, string rendering, bool quoted, int end)
class Block(string kind, defs.Position start, bool parent, chosen := false, active := false, else_seen := false, int | none skip_start := none)
class Saved(int | none definition)
class Inclusion(string path, int depth, int file_index)
    display_name := path
    offset := 0
    Block[] blocks := []
    lexer.Token[] segment := []

    defs.Position position(int physical)
        return defs.Position(display_name, physical + offset)

    bool active()
        return #blocks == 0 or blocks[-1].active

class Context(expansion := expander.Context(), manager := includes.Manager(), string[] history := [], string[] ever := [], string[] poisoned := [], saves := map<string, Saved[]>(), string[] output := [], tree := ["main.c"], string[] records := [], string[] results := [], string[] regions := [], previous := defs.Position("main.c", 0))
class Test(bool taken, string text)

void record_diagnostic(Context &context, const defs.Position position, string kind, string message)
    expander.diagnostic(&context.expansion, position, kind, message)

void event(Context &context, const defs.Position position, string text)
    context.history = context.history.append("{position.text()}: {text}")

void poison_check(Context &context, const lexer.Token[] tokens, const Inclusion state)
    for token := tokens[]
        if token.kind == "identifier" and lexer.has(context.poisoned, token.text)
            record_diagnostic(&context, state.position(token.line), "error", "attempt to use poisoned {DQ}{token.text}{DQ}")

void unused(Context &context, const defs.Macro definition)
    if definition.main_file and definition.expanded == 0 and definition.tested == 0
        record_diagnostic(&context, definition.position, "warning", "macro {DQ}{definition.name}{DQ} is not used")

void define_macro(Context &context, const lexer.Token[] tokens, const defs.Position position, bool main_file)
    definition := defs.Macro("", false, [], false, [], position, main_file)
    match defs.parse(tokens, position, main_file)
        defs.Macro found
            definition = found
        defs.Problem problem
            record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", problem.reason)
            return
    match context.expansion.table.get(definition.name)
        int old_index
            old := context.expansion.definitions[old_index]
            if defs.identical(old, definition)
                event(&context, position, "identical " + definition.signature())
                return
            unused(&context, old)
            record_diagnostic(&context, position, "warning", "{DQ}{definition.name}{DQ} redefined (previous definition at {old.position.text()})")
            event(&context, position, "redefine " + definition.signature())
        none
            event(&context, position, "define " + definition.signature())
    index := int(#context.expansion.definitions)
    context.expansion.definitions = context.expansion.definitions.append(definition)
    .context.expansion.table.set(definition.name, index)
    context.ever = lexer.unique(context.ever.append(definition.name))

void undef_macro(Context &context, const lexer.Token[] tokens, const defs.Position position)
    name := ""
    match defs.macro_name(tokens, "undef")
        string found
            name = found
        defs.Problem problem
            record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", problem.reason)
            return
    if #tokens > 1
        record_diagnostic(&context, position, "warning", "extra tokens at end of #undef directive")
    match context.expansion.table.get(name)
        int index
            unused(&context, context.expansion.definitions[index])
            .context.expansion.table.remove(name)
            event(&context, position, "undef {name}")
        none
            event(&context, position, "undef {name} (not defined)")

void marker(Context &context, string display_name, int line, flag := "")
    context.output = context.output.append("# {line} {DQ}{display_name}{DQ}{flag}")
    context.previous = defs.Position(display_name, line - 1)

void output_line(Context &context, string text, int physical, const Inclusion state)
    position := state.position(physical)
    if context.previous.display_name == position.display_name and context.previous.line < position.line and position.line <= context.previous.line + 8
        for: iteration < position.line - context.previous.line - 1
            context.output = context.output.append("")
    else
        marker(&context, position.display_name, position.line)
    context.output = context.output.append(text)
    context.previous = position
    context.manager.files[state.file_index].output_lines += 1

void flush_segment(Context &context, Inclusion &state)
    poison_check(&context, state.segment, state)
    tokens := expander.expand(&context.expansion, state.segment, state.display_name, state.offset)
    state.segment = []
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#tokens)
        finish := cursor + 1
        while finish < int(#tokens) and tokens[finish].line == tokens[cursor].line
            finish += 1
        output_line(&context, lexer.render(tokens[cursor:<finish], true), tokens[cursor].line, state)
        cursor = finish

bool is_defined(Context &context, string name)
    match context.expansion.table.get(name)
        int index
            context.expansion.definitions[index].tested += 1
            return true
        none
            return defs.builtin(name) or name == "__has_include"

Header | none | defs.Problem read_header(const lexer.Token[] tokens, index := 0)
    if index >= int(#tokens)
        return none
    token := tokens[index]
    if token.kind == "string" or token.kind == "header"
        return Header(token.text[1:<int(#token.text) - 1], token.text, token.kind == "string", index + 1)
    if token.text == "<"
        finish := index + 1
        while finish < int(#tokens) and tokens[finish].text != ">"
            finish += 1
        if finish == int(#tokens)
            return defs.Problem("missing terminating > character")
        name := lexer.render(tokens[index + 1:<finish])
        return Header(name, "<{name}>", false, finish + 1)
    return none

lexer.Token[] | defs.Problem replace_operators(Context &context, const lexer.Token[] tokens)
    lexer.Token[] result := []
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#tokens)
        token := tokens[cursor]
        if token.kind == "identifier" and token.text == "defined"
            cursor += 1
            parenthesized := cursor < int(#tokens) and tokens[cursor].text == "("
            if parenthesized
                cursor += 1
            if cursor == int(#tokens) or tokens[cursor].kind != "identifier"
                return defs.Problem("operator {DQ}defined{DQ} requires an identifier")
            name := tokens[cursor].text
            cursor += 1
            if parenthesized
                if cursor == int(#tokens) or tokens[cursor].text != ")"
                    return defs.Problem("missing ')' after {DQ}defined{DQ}")
                cursor += 1
            present := is_defined(&context, name)
            result = result.append(lexer.Token("number", if present then "1" else "0", token.line, token.space))
        elif token.kind == "identifier" and token.text == "__has_include"
            cursor += 1
            if cursor == int(#tokens) or tokens[cursor].text != "("
                return defs.Problem("missing '(' after {DQ}__has_include{DQ}")
            cursor += 1
            header := Header("", "", false, 0)
            match read_header(tokens, cursor)
                Header found
                    header = found
                none
                    return defs.Problem("operator {DQ}__has_include{DQ} requires a header-name")
                defs.Problem problem
                    return problem
            if header.name == ""
                return defs.Problem("operator {DQ}__has_include{DQ} requires a header-name")
            cursor = header.end
            if cursor == int(#tokens) or tokens[cursor].text != ")"
                return defs.Problem("missing ')' after {DQ}__has_include{DQ} operand")
            cursor += 1
            present := false
            match includes.search(header.name, header.quoted)
                string found
                    present = true
                none
                    present = false
            result = result.append(lexer.Token("number", if present then "1" else "0", token.line, token.space))
        else
            result = result.append(token)
            cursor += 1
    return result

Test test_condition(Context &context, string directive, const lexer.Token[] tokens, const defs.Position position, const Inclusion state)
    poison_check(&context, tokens, state)
    if directive != "if" and directive != "elif"
        if #tokens == 0
            record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", "no macro name given in #{directive} directive")
            return Test(false, "not taken (error)")
        if tokens[0].kind != "identifier"
            record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", "macro names must be identifiers")
            return Test(false, "not taken (error)")
        if #tokens > 1
            record_diagnostic(&context, position, "warning", "extra tokens at end of #{directive} directive")
        present := is_defined(&context, tokens[0].text)
        taken := if directive == "ifndef" or directive == "elifndef" then not present else present
        return Test(taken, if taken then "taken" else "not taken")
    lexer.Token[] replaced := []
    match replace_operators(&context, tokens)
        lexer.Token[] found
            replaced = found
        defs.Problem problem
            record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", problem.reason)
            return Test(false, "not taken (error)")
    expanded := expander.expand(&context.expansion, replaced, state.display_name, state.offset)
    result := expression.test(expanded, directive)
    for message := result.messages[]
        record_diagnostic(&context, position, message.kind, message.text)
    suffix := " [" + lexer.render(expanded, true) + "]"
    match result.value
        int value
            taken := value != 0
            return Test(taken, (if taken then "taken" else "not taken") + " (value {value})" + suffix)
        none
            return Test(false, "not taken (error)" + suffix)

void close_region(Context &context, Block &block, int finish, const Inclusion state)
    match block.skip_start
        int start
            if finish >= start
                count := finish - start + 1
                context.regions = context.regions.append("{state.display_name}:{start + state.offset}-{finish + state.offset} lines={count}")
                context.manager.files[state.file_index].skipped_lines += count
        none
            block.skip_start = none
    block.skip_start = none

void conditional(Context &context, Inclusion &state, string directive, const lexer.Token[] operands, const lexer.LogicalLine line)
    position := state.position(line.tokens[0].line)
    opening := lexer.has(["if", "ifdef", "ifndef"], directive)
    indentation := int(#state.blocks) - (if opening then 0 else 1)
    outcome := ""
    if opening
        block := Block(directive, position, state.active())
        if block.parent
            result := test_condition(&context, directive, operands, position, state)
            block.active = result.taken
            block.chosen = result.taken
            outcome = result.text
            if not block.active
                block.skip_start = line.end + 1
        else
            outcome = "skipped"
        state.blocks = state.blocks.append(block)
    else
        if #state.blocks == 0
            record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", "#{directive} without #if")
            return
        last := int(#state.blocks) - 1
        block := state.blocks[last]
        close_region(&context, &block, line.start - 1, state)
        if directive == "endif"
            state.blocks = state.blocks[0:<last]
            if block.parent and #operands > 0
                record_diagnostic(&context, position, "warning", "extra tokens at end of #endif directive")
            outcome = "closes #{block.kind} at line {block.start.line}"
        else
            if block.else_seen
                record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", "#{directive} after #else")
            if directive == "else"
                if block.parent and #operands > 0
                    record_diagnostic(&context, position, "warning", "extra tokens at end of #else directive")
                block.else_seen = true
                if block.parent
                    block.active = not block.chosen
                    block.chosen = true
                    outcome = if block.active then "taken" else "not taken"
                else
                    outcome = "skipped"
            elif not block.parent
                block.active = false
                outcome = "skipped"
            elif block.chosen
                block.active = false
                outcome = "not evaluated"
            else
                result := test_condition(&context, directive, operands, position, state)
                block.active = result.taken
                block.chosen = block.chosen or result.taken
                outcome = result.text
            if block.parent and not block.active
                block.skip_start = line.end + 1
            state.blocks[last] = block
    rendering := "#{directive}" + (if #operands == 0 then "" else " " + lexer.render(operands))
    context.records = context.records.append("{position.text()}: " + lexer.repeat(" ", 2 * indentation) + rendering + " => " + outcome)
    context.results = context.results.append(outcome)

void process_file(Context &context, string path, int depth);

void include_file(Context &context, const Inclusion state, const lexer.Token[] operands, const lexer.LogicalLine line)
    position := state.position(line.tokens[0].line)
    tokens := operands
    Header | none specification := none
    match read_header(tokens)
        Header found
            specification = found
        defs.Problem problem
            record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", problem.reason)
            return
        none
            if #tokens > 0
                tokens = expander.expand(&context.expansion, tokens, state.display_name, state.offset)
                match read_header(tokens)
                    Header found
                        specification = found
                    defs.Problem problem
                        record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", problem.reason)
                        return
                    none
                        specification = none
    header := Header("", "", false, 0)
    match specification
        Header found
            header = found
        none
            record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", "#include expects {DQ}FILENAME{DQ} or <FILENAME>")
            return
    if header.end < int(#tokens)
        record_diagnostic(&context, position, "warning", "extra tokens at end of #include directive")
    if header.name == ""
        record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", "empty filename in #include")
        return
    prefix := lexer.repeat(" ", 2 * (state.depth + 1)) + "{line.tokens[0].line}: "
    path := ""
    match includes.search(header.name, header.quoted)
        string found
            path = found
        none
            context.tree = context.tree.append(prefix + header.rendering + " [not found]")
            record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", "cannot find include file " + header.rendering)
            return
    match context.manager.lookup.get(path)
        int index
            includes.SourceFile cached := context.manager.files[index]
            reason := ""
            if cached.once
                reason = "pragma once"
            else
                match cached.guard
                    string name
                        if context.expansion.table.has(name)
                            reason = "guard {name}"
                    none
                        reason = ""
            if reason != ""
                context.tree = context.tree.append(prefix + path + " [skipped: {reason}]")
                context.manager.files[index].skipped += 1
                return
        none
            path = path
    if state.depth + 1 > 8
        context.tree = context.tree.append(prefix + path + " [too deep]")
        record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", "#include nested too deeply")
        return
    context.tree = context.tree.append(prefix + path)
    marker(&context, path, 1, " 1")
    process_file(&context, path, state.depth + 1)
    marker(&context, state.display_name, line.end + 1 + state.offset, " 2")

bool decimal_token(const lexer.Token token)
    if token.kind != "number" or #token.text == 0
        return false
    for: index < int(#token.text)
        if not lexer.digit(token.text[index])
            return false
    return true

void line_directive(Context &context, Inclusion &state, const lexer.Token[] original, const lexer.LogicalLine line)
    position := state.position(line.tokens[0].line)
    tokens := original
    if #tokens == 0 or not decimal_token(tokens[0])
        tokens = expander.expand(&context.expansion, tokens, state.display_name, state.offset)
    if #tokens < 1 or #tokens > 2 or not decimal_token(tokens[0]) or (#tokens == 2 and tokens[1].kind != "string")
        record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", "invalid #line directive")
        return
    number := int(tokens[0].text)
    if number < 1 or number > 2147483647
        record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", "line number out of range")
        return
    state.offset = number - line.end - 1
    if #tokens == 2
        state.display_name = tokens[1].text[1:<int(#tokens[1].text) - 1]

void pragma(Context &context, const Inclusion state, const lexer.Token[] tokens, int physical)
    position := state.position(physical)
    first := if #tokens > 0 then tokens[0].text else ""
    identifier := #tokens > 0 and tokens[0].kind == "identifier"
    if identifier and first == "once"
        if #tokens > 1
            record_diagnostic(&context, position, "warning", "extra tokens at end of #pragma once directive")
        if state.depth == 0
            record_diagnostic(&context, position, "warning", "#pragma once in main file")
        context.manager.files[state.file_index].once = true
    elif #tokens >= 2 and first == "GCC" and tokens[1].text == "poison"
        names := tokens[2:<int(#tokens)]
        for token := names[]
            if token.kind != "identifier"
                record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", "invalid #pragma GCC poison directive")
                return
        for token := names[]
            if context.expansion.table.has(token.text)
                record_diagnostic(&context, position, "warning", "poisoning existing macro {DQ}{token.text}{DQ}")
            context.poisoned = lexer.unique(context.poisoned.append(token.text))
    elif identifier and (first == "push_macro" or first == "pop_macro")
        if #tokens != 4 or tokens[1].text != "(" or tokens[2].kind != "string" or tokens[3].text != ")"
            record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", "invalid #pragma {first} directive")
            return
        name := tokens[2].text[1:<int(#tokens[2].text) - 1]
        Saved[] stack := []
        match context.saves.get(name)
            Saved[] found
                stack = found
            none
                stack = []
        if first == "push_macro"
            stack = stack.append(Saved(context.expansion.table.get(name)))
            .context.saves.set(name, stack)
            event(&context, position, "push {name}")
        elif #stack == 0
            record_diagnostic(&context, position, "warning", "no matching push_macro for {DQ}{name}{DQ}")
        else
            saved := stack[-1]
            stack = stack[0:<int(#stack) - 1]
            .context.saves.set(name, stack)
            match saved.definition
                int index
                    .context.expansion.table.set(name, index)
                    event(&context, position, "pop {name}")
                none
                    .context.expansion.table.remove(name)
                    event(&context, position, "pop {name} (undefined)")
    else
        output_line(&context, "#pragma" + (if #tokens == 0 then "" else " " + lexer.render(tokens)), physical, state)

void process_file(Context &context, string path, int depth)
    index := includes.enter(&context.manager, path)
    state := Inclusion(path, depth, index)
    lexer.LogicalLine[] lines := context.manager.files[index].lines
    for line := lines[]
        directive_line := #line.tokens > 0 and line.tokens[0].text == "#"
        if directive_line
            flush_segment(&context, &state)
            if #line.tokens == 1
                continue
            string directive := line.tokens[1].text
            lexer.Token[] operands := line.tokens[2:<int(#line.tokens)]
            if line.tokens[1].kind == "identifier" and lexer.has(["if", "ifdef", "ifndef", "elif", "elifdef", "elifndef", "else", "endif"], directive)
                conditional(&context, &state, directive, operands, line)
                continue
            if not state.active()
                continue
            poisoning := directive == "pragma" and #operands >= 2 and operands[0].text == "GCC" and operands[1].text == "poison"
            if not poisoning
                poison_check(&context, operands, state)
            position := state.position(line.tokens[0].line)
            if directive == "define"
                define_macro(&context, operands, position, depth == 0)
            elif directive == "undef"
                undef_macro(&context, operands, position)
            elif directive == "include"
                include_file(&context, state, operands, line)
            elif directive == "line"
                line_directive(&context, &state, operands, line)
            elif directive == "error" or directive == "warning"
                record_diagnostic(&context, position, directive, "#{directive}" + (if #operands == 0 then "" else " " + lexer.render(operands)))
            elif directive == "pragma"
                pragma(&context, state, operands, line.tokens[0].line)
            else
                record_diagnostic(&context, position, "error", "invalid preprocessing directive #{directive}")
        elif state.active()
            state.segment = state.segment.concat(line.tokens)
    flush_segment(&context, &state)
    for: block_index < int(#state.blocks)
        block := state.blocks[block_index]
        close_region(&context, &block, context.manager.files[index].physical_lines, state)
        state.blocks[block_index] = block
    for block := state.blocks[]
        record_diagnostic(&context, block.start, "error", "unterminated #{block.kind}")

string list_line(string heading, const string[] items)
    return heading + (if #items == 0 then "" else " " + items.join(" "))

string[] references(const Context context, const defs.Macro definition)
    string[] result := []
    for token := definition.replacement[]
        if token.kind == "identifier" and context.expansion.table.has(token.text) and not lexer.has(definition.parameters, token.text)
            result = result.append(token.text)
    return lexer.unique(result).sorted()

bool cycle_reaches(const map<string, string[]> graph, string current, string target, string[] visited)
    if lexer.has(visited, current)
        return false
    visited = visited.append(current)
    string[] successors := []
    match graph.get(current)
        string[] found
            successors = found
        none
            return false
    for successor := successors[]
        if successor == target or cycle_reaches(graph, successor, target, visited)
            return true
    return false

string[] include_lines(const Context context)
    string[] result := context.tree.concat(["", "== files =="])
    paths := context.manager.lookup.keys()
    for path := paths.sorted()[]
        index := -1
        match context.manager.lookup.get(path)
            int found
                index = found
            none
                continue
        includes.SourceFile source := context.manager.files[index]
        guard := "-"
        match source.guard
            string found
                guard = found
            none
                guard = "-"
        once := if source.once then "yes" else "no"
        result = result.append("{path} entered={source.entered} skipped={source.skipped} lines={source.physical_lines} output_lines={source.output_lines} skipped_lines={source.skipped_lines} guard={guard} once={once}")
    result = result.append("")
    dependency := "main.o:"
    has_path := false
    for path := context.manager.order[]
        if #dependency + 1 + #path > 76 and has_path
            result = result.append(dependency + " \")
            dependency = " "
            has_path = false
        dependency += " " + path
        has_path = true
    return result.append(dependency)

string[] macro_lines(const Context context)
    names := context.expansion.table.keys()
    names = names.sorted()
    map<string, string[]> graph
    for name := names[]
        match context.expansion.table.get(name)
            int index
                .graph.set(name, references(context, context.expansion.definitions[index]))
            none
                continue
    result := ["== history =="]
    result = result.concat(context.history).concat(["", "== table =="])
    functions := 0
    for name := names[]
        index := -1
        match context.expansion.table.get(name)
            int found
                index = found
            none
                continue
        definition := context.expansion.definitions[index]
        if definition.function_like
            functions += 1
        recursive := if cycle_reaches(graph, name, name, []) then "yes" else "no"
        result = result.append(definition.definition())
        result = result.append("  at {definition.position.text()} expanded={definition.expanded} tested={definition.tested} recursive={recursive}")
        result = result.append(list_line("  refs:", references(context, definition)))
    string[] undefined_names := []
    for name := context.ever.sorted()[]
        if not context.expansion.table.has(name)
            undefined_names = undefined_names.append(name)
    result = result.concat(["", "macros={#names} object_like={int(#names) - functions} function_like={functions}"])
    result = result.append(list_line("undefined:", undefined_names))
    return result.append("builtins: __COUNTER__={context.expansion.uses[2]} __FILE__={context.expansion.uses[1]} __LINE__={context.expansion.uses[0]}")

string[] conditional_lines(const Context context)
    prefixes := ["taken", "not taken", "skipped", "not evaluated", "closes"]
    counts := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    for outcome := context.results[]
        for: index < int(#prefixes)
            if outcome.starts_with(prefixes[index])
                counts[index] += 1
    string[] result := context.records.concat(["", "== skipped regions =="]).concat(context.regions)
    return result.concat(["", "directives={#context.records} taken={counts[0]} not_taken={counts[1]} skipped={counts[2]} not_evaluated={counts[3]} endif={counts[4]} regions={#context.regions}"])

string[] diagnostic_lines(const Context context)
    string[] result := []
    errors := 0
    warnings := 0
    for diagnostic := context.expansion.diagnostics[]
        result = result.append("{diagnostic.position.text()}: {diagnostic.kind}: {diagnostic.message}")
        if diagnostic.kind == "error"
            errors += 1
        else
            warnings += 1
    return result.append("errors={errors} warnings={warnings}")

void write_lines(string name, const string[] lines)
    string text := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
    writer1 := file.write("output/{name}")
    .writer1(text)

void run_program()
    context := Context()
    string presets := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/defines.txt"))
    lines := presets.split(NL)
    for: index < int(#lines)
        line := lines[index]
        if line == ""
            continue
        equals := -1
        for: character_index < int(#line)
            if line[character_index] == "="
                equals = character_index
                break
        if equals >= 0
            line = line[0:<equals] + " " + line[equals + 1:<int(#line)]
        else
            line += " 1"
        lexer.Token[] tokens := []
        for logical_line := lexer.lex(line + NL)[]
            tokens = tokens.concat(logical_line.tokens)
        define_macro(&context, tokens, defs.Position("defines.txt", index + 1), false)
    marker(&context, "main.c", 1)
    process_file(&context, "main.c", 0)
    names := context.expansion.table.keys()
    for name := names.sorted()[]
        match context.expansion.table.get(name)
            int index
                unused(&context, context.expansion.definitions[index])
            none
                continue
    bool exists := file.exists("output")
    if not exists
        file.mkdir("output")
